title: Comercio y cooperación
goal: Read how NAFTA (1994) boosted Mexican export manufacturing while squeezing small corn farmers against subsidized US imports, alongside the 1994 Group of Three and the region's growing "spaghetti bowl" of overlapping trade deals.

items: Explain what NAFTA transformed in Mexican manufacturing.
Explain what small Mexican corn farmers faced under NAFTA.
State what the Group of Three was and when it was signed.
Describe the "spaghetti bowl" of trade agreements.
Use así las cosas to resume narration after describing a situation.
